canDoYue: 你識用餐時添水、要餐巾，仲識讚好味。
canDoEn: Ask for a refill or a napkin during the meal, and say the food is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?
dialogue.glossYue: 你食到而家開唔開心？我哋可唔可以而家幫你添杯凍嘅？
dialogue.say: Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以嚟杯冇氣水，同埋多一張乾淨餐巾畀呢支叉？
dialogue.say: Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Here is the still water, and the napkin is next to your knife.
dialogue.glossYue: 冇氣水喺度，餐巾喺你把刀隔離。
dialogue.say: Here is the still water, and the napkin is next to your knife.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more sparkling water.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢條魚好味，我想要多啲有氣水。
dialogue.say: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more sparkling water.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the rest of it.
dialogue.glossYue: 有氣水就到，希望你慢慢享受餘下嗰啲。
dialogue.say: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the rest of it.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: No dessert for me, but could we get the bill a little later tonight?
dialogue.glossYue: 我唔要甜品，不過今晚可唔可以遲啲先埋單？
dialogue.say: No dessert for me, but could we get the bill a little later tonight?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Of course, and would you like anything else before I leave the table?
dialogue.glossYue: 當然可以，我離開之前你仲想唔想要其他嘢？
dialogue.say: Of course, and would you like anything else before I leave the table?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The meal was delicious, and a coffee later would be perfect, thank you.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢餐好味，遲啲嚟杯咖啡就完美，多謝。
dialogue.say: The meal was delicious, and a coffee later would be perfect, thank you.

still water 同 sparkling water 差喺？
understand.explain: still 係冇氣，sparkling 係有氣。

understand.prompt: This is delicious. 呢句即係點？

quiz.prompt: 聽一次，揀你聽到嘅字：碟旁邊嗰塊布
聽一次，揀你聽到嘅字：客人覺得魚好食
客人講「Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?」，係咩意思？
客人講「Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?」，係咩意思？

quiz.explain: delicious 中間有 /l/。napkin 同 fork 冇。

sound.title: 好味中間嗰個音
sound.note: delicious 中間係 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面。napkin 開頭係 /n/。fork 開頭係 /f/。
